method: Read-only remote comparison of the earlier real-freeze outputs against the final decision-only outputs at the same length/task cells; input_sha256 equality was asserted before comparing skip lists and all 36 near/far profile means.
limitations: Only the 22 complete 64K/128K cells from the earlier real-freeze run are compared; 32K real-freeze production was incomplete.
The earlier real-freeze files remain secondary cross-check evidence and are not part of the primary 33-cell dataset.
This comparison does not validate physical freeze/reclaim or decode behavior.
